summary.fr: Maître chan chinois du IXe siècle, connu pour son enseignement abrupt (cris, coups, paradoxes) ; l'école qui porte son nom devint au Japon le Zen Rinzai.
summary.en: Ninth-century Chinese Chan master, known for his abrupt teaching (shouts, blows, paradoxes); the school bearing his name became Rinzai Zen in Japan.
